scripts.dev:backend: uv run --directory backend python -m uvicorn app.api.main:app --reload --port 8000
scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend
scripts.lint:backend: uv run --project backend ruff check backend && uv run --directory backend lint-imports
scripts.lint: npm run lint:backend && npm run lint:frontend
scripts.typecheck:backend: uv run --directory backend python -m mypy app
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:backend && npm run typecheck:frontend
